verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents a broad public API surface. It covers HTTP V2 event ingestion, event export, the Dashboard REST API for chart data in JSON, and cohort list/export/upload. It also offers taxonomy create/read/update/delete for event types and properties, plus Experiment APIs for managing flags and experiments from scripts or CI. A probe confirmed a live openapi.json spec, so an agent can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents or scripts actually driving these APIs, and in-depth evidence on API auth, limits and coverage (the doc snippets are one-line summaries).
